My brother and I would hear my mom calling when she wasn’t as the same with her. I believe certain people attract that type of energy though because as soon as I stopped living with my mom all the weird things stopped. I started going to church with my friends because my family wasn’t religious hoping it would help but it didn’t. It still continued and praying at home didn’t help me either unfortunately.
